message: You know that one friend who always seems to panic at the mere mention of fire safety? 😅 Well, I’ve learned that it’s much better to be prepared than to scramble in a moment of surprise! I found this great resource from the NFPA that really breaks down how to keep our homes safe from fire hazards. It’s all about simple steps we can take to protect our loved ones and enjoy our cozy spaces. Maybe it’s time we all brush up on our fire safety skills—what do you think?
